title: Japanese Potato Stir Fry
description: A simple and delicious Japanese-inspired potato stir fry made with crispy potatoes and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add diced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, or until crispy.
Add stir fry sauce and green onions to the skillet.
Stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the potato stir fry to a serving dish and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
